Our Story

Find your way back to simple living.

Surrounded by nature and shaped by rustic charm, SriTulasi offers a refreshing change of pace. Wooden cottages, open surroundings and peaceful riverside views invite you to pause and unwind.

Mornings begin with rustling palms, afternoons drift beside the water, and evenings settle into the warmth of raw timber.
